description: This file is a shell script used for setting up a Python virtual environment, cloning repositories, and installing requirements, with functions for logging and error handling.

methods.name: install_pip_requirements
methods.description: Installs Python requirements from a file, using SHA256 checksum to avoid reinstallation if unchanged.

methods.name: clone_repo
methods.description: Clones a git repository if not already present and checks out a specific version.

methods.name: setup_and_enable_venv
methods.description: Creates and activates a Python virtual environment if not already active.

methods.name: DUMP_VAR
methods.description: Prints the value of a variable for debugging.

methods.name: DEBUG
methods.description: Outputs debug messages if debugging is enabled.
